title: Replicating NIST AI 800-1 Comment Analysis Methodology on EU AI Act GPAI Code of Practice

original_idea.body:
# Replicating NIST AI 800-1 Comment Analysis Methodology on EU AI Act GPAI Code of Practice

**Problem:** The EU's GPAI Code of Practice went through a similar public consultation process to NIST AI 800-1. Whether stakeholder comments substantively influenced cybersecurity/dual-use provisions is unstudied.

**Direction:** Apply the comment tracking methodology from the NIST follow-up experiment to the EU GPAI Code of Practice: compare Draft 1 vs. Draft 3 of the security provisions. Sample 15 stakeholder comment submissions. Measure comment-to-change traceability for cybersecurity provisions specifically.

**Why it matters:** Cross-jurisdictional comparison of comment process effectiveness reveals whether public consultation is genuinely governance-shaping or ritualistic, and whether this varies by region.

**Relevant context:** EU GPAI Code of Practice July 2025; EU AI Act August 2026 compliance; NIST AI 800-1 comment analysis.
